description: qou-cds1 Step 28. Step 27 stopped because an all-pairs coupling needs a falloff rate per bond type and three fitted rates would be three free parameters. They are not free. The math-ideal CAL triple is (m_e, D_beta, D_pi) at orders h^0/h^2/h^3 — CAL-2 and CAL-3 are the neutron beta-decay and pion decay WIDTHS, i.e. two of the three calibration points are decay rates by definition. And `chi_monotone_transfer._alpha_beta` reduces each fine-Bratteli transfer step to O_g = alpha.sigma_g + beta.I with spectrum E_1 = Prod(q+d_j), E_2 = Prod(-1/q+d_j), so the falloff across one bond is the spectral ratio E_2/E_1. In closed form: -1/q^2 for p-p, -q^2 for n-n, EXACTLY -1 for the averaged p-n. THEY ARE NOT INDEPENDENT: r_pp.r_nn = 1 = r_pn^2 and r_nn/r_pp = q^4, so three rates carry one degree of freedom. AND THEY ARE SECTOR-INDEXED: under the bar involution p-p and n-n exchange while p-n is fixed; their product is bar-even (the taxonomy's STRONG cosh channel) and their ratio bar-odd (its WEAK sinh channel). The colour-weighted p-n bond's departure from -1 is tanh(ln q).delta + O(delta^2), and tanh(ln q_0) = 0.103963710 is exactly the odd-to-even ratio the taxonomy also quotes for its EM coupling — but that match is FORMAL and is WITHDRAWN (qou-i9gk, 2026-09-01): `q` alone has the same odd/even ratio. Predicted 1.4302400e-4 against measured 1.4301377e-4, agreeing to 7.2e-5. delta vanishes to order h^3, CAL-3's order. What this does NOT do: supply the coupling word — a non-adjacent nucleon pair still has no single generator to sit on.

assertions.name: bond_rates_are_closed_forms_and_like_nucleon_bonds_coincide
assertions.detail: the transfer step's spectrum is E_1 = Prod(q + d_j), E_2 = Prod(-1/q + d_j) (`chi_monotone_transfer._alpha_beta`), so the per-bond falloff is the SPECTRAL GAP |lambda_2/lambda_1|: exactly 1/q^2 for BOTH p-p and n-n (sigma^-1 carries sigma's spectrum up to sign) and exactly 1 for the averaged p-n, which is therefore LONG-RANGE. Closed forms in q with no free parameter, which removes Step 27's three-free-parameter objection. CORRECTS this probe's first version (E_2/E_1 in fixed order gave q^2 for n-n); bean qou-brng derived the same object correctly on main

assertions.name: the_one_dof_and_sector_claims_are_withdrawn
assertions.detail: r_pp . r_nn = 0.658781817 rather than 1, so the 'one exact relation, one degree of freedom' claim is false; and p-p = n-n exactly, so they do not exchange under the bar and the strong/weak sector assignment built on that exchange is vacuous. Both are withdrawn and neither is restated. The exchange was partly circular in any case: d = 0 and d = -h are sigma and sigma^-1, bar-images of each other by definition

assertions.name: pn_departure_is_the_electromagnetic_ratio_times_the_flavour_split
assertions.detail: 1 - |r_pn| = 2.delta.(q^2-1)/(delta.(q^2-1) + 2q^2 + 2), whose leading coefficient is (q^2-1)/(q^2+1) = tanh(ln q). At the pin tanh(ln q_0) = 0.103963710052. The taxonomy quotes the same number for its EM coupling, but that match is FORMAL and is WITHDRAWN (qou-i9gk): `q` alone has the ratio. Predicted 0.0001430239995 against measured 0.0001430137723, agreeing to 7.151e-5 relative — the second order in delta. SELF-RAISED CAVEAT (bean qou-i9gk): tanh(ln q) is just 'odd part over even part', which any bar decomposition produces, so this may be two instances of one triviality rather than a link. Unlike the withdrawn sector claim it is at least a numerical coincidence that has to be explained away rather than a restated definition

assertions.name: flavour_split_sits_at_CAL3_h_order
assertions.detail: delta = flavor_split_leading(q) vanishes to order 2.9999902 in (q-1) — h^3, the order the math-ideal CAL ladder assigns to CAL-3 (D_pi, the pion decay width). tanh(ln q) is O(h), so 1 - |r_pn| is O(h^4) while both like-nucleon rates are the q-independent-in-order 1/q^2. The canonical triple is (m_e, D_beta, D_pi) at h^0/h^2/h^3, so two of the three calibration points are decay rates by definition

parameters.cal_triple: math ideal (m_e, D_beta, D_pi) at h^0/h^2/h^3

withdrawn: r_pp . r_nn = r_pn^2 (one degree of freedom)

context.axis: qou-cds1: are the all-pairs bond decay rates free parameters, or are they already determined by the CAL definitions and the tower's transfer matrix?
context.answer: Determined. The rate across a bond is the transfer step's spectral ratio E_2/E_1, a closed form in q for every bond template; the three rates satisfy r_pp.r_nn = r_pn^2 so they carry one degree of freedom rather than three; and their bar parity reproduces the interaction-sector taxonomy, with the p-n departure carrying tanh(ln q_0), the taxonomy's own electromagnetic odd-to-even ratio. The three-free-parameter objection that stopped Step 27 is removed.
context.does_not_close: The coupling WORD. A non-adjacent nucleon pair has no single generator to sit on, so building the all-pairs braid remains a construction.
